items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: And so there was a great friend of my family, a fellow that called Foots used to work at the parties market. Foots was a bouncer there and Foots used to carry me there and let me hear Bunk play.

ctx.x: Do you remember the first bands you heard or you heard your father?

Yeah, the first good jazz band I heard was the Eagle Band with Bunk. With Bunk. How did you? Bunk was the man that really knocked me out. And the first time I heard Bunk, I got in my head that I wanted to play cornet just like Bunk did. Bunk did. Well Bunk played in the town of Ruffport City. The old funky but all on Padilla Street. Well yeah I took a picture of that. And so there was a great friend of my family, a fellow that called Foots used to work at the parties market. Foots was a bouncer there and Foots…
Did he really have great big feet I think Bunk told me about it. Yeah he had big feet. Foots was a bouncer and had feet almost big as the funky but all.
